source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Try to full the SEL
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a log when sensor reach to threshold.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo ipmitool sdr elist 2>&1; echo ---; sudo ipmitool sensor list 2>&1"

original_test_intent: Exercise an informational-error sensor event, verify SDR/threshold data and correlate the event with SEL behavior, potentially at SEL capacity.
original_method: The same thermal/SEL-fill procedure as RealErr is used without defining how InfoErr stimulus or expected event differs.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer establishes the approved physical stimulus; software can monitor synchronized telemetry/SEL. Any capacity fill remains separately controlled.
required_inputs: InfoErr definition and distinction from RealErr
Target sensor, thresholds and safe stimulus
safety_requirements: Do not infer or inject an InfoErr or fill/clear SEL while undefined.
Preserve existing SEL and use independent recovery.
No automatic retry or loss of first evidence.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, collect SDR/sensor/SEL/console evidence and classify the supplied event against the approved mapping.
Do not create physical fault, fill/clear SEL or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Define InfoErr and safe stimulus/capacity scope.
Operate physical setup and decide verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Static reads are baseline-only; they cannot generate or classify InfoErr or full-SEL behavior, and the transport bypass is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No stimulus until the event class is defined; then use trusted synchronized read-only collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Commands, identical RealErr procedure, script and 5/10-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define one explicit informational event and expected severity/OEM code, separate it from RealErr and any SEL-capacity test, then correlate stimulus, assert/deassert and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor event/SEL severity mapping and capacity documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing InfoErr identity and splits capacity coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents identical execution from claiming two distinct event classes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong stimulus may create a real hardware fault or overwrite evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may select a safe informational event and omit capacity coverage, documenting reduced scope; it cannot reuse RealErr evidence without event-class proof.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: InfoErr and RealErr rows have identical procedure/criteria with no event-class distinction; the same code also identifies unrelated DIMM Information at row 1487.

blocked_analysis.analysis: No operation or evidence distinguishes InfoErr from RealErr, and `full the SEL` remains ambiguous/destructive; the test would otherwise be a duplicate claim.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on BLOCKED for event semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates ordinary threshold inputs from the true missing event identity.

review_improvement: Requires class-specific event proof and duplicate-row identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two cases cannot claim different event coverage from identical stimuli/log checks unless a platform event mapping distinguishes them. That mapping is absent and cannot be guessed.
